name: Haus Helga
beschreibung: The Haus Helga is located in the Kappl district in the Tiroler Paznauntal and offers an ideal starting point for outdoor activities. The rooms are furnished in Alpine country style and have private bathrooms and balconies. The inn offers traditional Tiroler dishes as well as breakfast and half board. In the immediate surroundings, the Skigebiet Kappl and marked hiking trails await. Cyclists use the Paznauntal-Radroute. The family-run accommodation is characterized by a personal and quiet atmosphere.
